vlm_table10.limit: Table10 does not establish a nine-image2815token/18output HTTP workload. Do not silently apply LLM four-text-token setting to this VLM table.

marlin.claim: Near4x FP16xINT4 matmul kernel speed, low/mediumM around16-32
marlin.scope: Ideal large matrix onA10 plus sums of Transformer linear-layer runtimes; not full multimodal HTTP
marlin.baseline: torch.matmul with preallocated output, one warmup/ten iterations; one synchronization around group of launches
marlin.format_limit: Original Layer is symmetric4bit and lacks per-group runtime zero-point input; it cannot directly consume current asymmetric AWQ-format qzeros without a proven compatible implementation.

local_comparison_limit: Current fixed primary workload is9images/2815inputtokens/18returnedtokens, fullnonstreamHTTP; it includes image handling,vision,prefill and service overhead.
Local FP16 already uses LMDeploy and nativeCUDA graph; it is not HuggingFace default.
Use matched local FP16 and numerical/fullmodel/task validation. Literature speedup is a feasibility reference, not a guaranteed local target.
